# Rigify basic-human template

`rigify-basic-human.py` is copied unchanged from Blender 5.1.2's official bundled
`scripts/addons_core/rigify/metarigs/Basic/basic_human.py` on this Mac.
Copyright 2017–2022 Blender Foundation, **GPL-2.0-or-later**, as retained in its header.
The template requires Blender and its bundled Rigify add-on; it is not a standalone
Python auto-rigger. The companion wrapper calls Rigify's existing `generate_rig`.

Upstream: https://projects.blender.org/blender/blender/src/branch/main/scripts/addons_core/rigify/metarigs/Basic/basic_human.py

Manual: https://docs.blender.org/manual/en/latest/addons/rigging/rigify/basics.html

License: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/old-licenses/gpl-2.0.html

Neither the template nor the wrapper was executed when added to LIFELINE.
